description: Defines the gtpu_echo_tx class for transmitting GTP-U path management messages, including methods for sending echo requests and responses, and handling echo responses.

classes.name: gtpu_echo_tx
classes.description: Class for transmitting GTP-U echo (path management) messages, including sending echo requests and responses.

methods.name: send_echo_request
methods.description: Constructs and sends a GTP-U echo request message to a specified destination address.

methods.name: send_echo_response
methods.description: Constructs and sends a GTP-U echo response message, including recovery information, to a specified destination address.

methods.name: handle_echo_response
methods.description: Handles an incoming echo response, currently logs receipt.
